name: 54153 · Oconto, WI
findings: ZIP 54153 (Oconto) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54153 (Oconto) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54153 (Oconto) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
